bib.title: Learning to Retrieve In-Context Examples for Large Language Models

question: Can a dense retriever be trained from frozen-LLM feedback to pick better in-context examples than BM25 or off-the-shelf embeddings, across many tasks and LLMs?
hypothesis: Ranking candidates by LLM log-likelihood of the gold output, distilling through a cross-encoder reward model, yields a retriever that selects higher-quality few-shot examples and generalises to unseen tasks and other LLMs.
contributions: LLM-R: iterative framework (LLM-ranked candidates, cross-encoder reward model, distilled bi-encoder retriever)
Evaluation on 30 tasks in 9 categories, with 4 held-out tasks and 3 other LLMs
Analysis of when learned retrieval helps (classification with many training examples) and when not (knowledge-intensive tasks)

method.summary: BM25 retrieves top-100 candidates per training example from a pooled example set; frozen LLaMA-7B ranks them by log p(y|x,xi,yi); an ELECTRA-base cross-encoder reward model is trained on top/bottom candidates and a shared-encoder E5-base bi-encoder is distilled from it (KL plus InfoNCE). Can iterate using the new retriever. At test time top-k retrieved examples are concatenated before the test input.
method.task: in-context example retrieval for few-shot prompting

datasets.name: 30 datasets from FLAN/UPRISE collection (Table 8)
datasets.size: pool about 6.3M train examples, 177k test; sampled 591k train and 123k test
datasets.split: max 30k train and 10k eval examples per dataset; QNLI, PIQA, WSC273, Yelp held out of training
datasets.preprocessing: retrieval candidate = input xi concatenated with output yi; query = input only; the example itself is excluded from its own retrieval; candidates from a different task than the query get a low score

models.name: LLaMA-7B
models.context: max input length 1024, left-truncated; max output 64

models.name: E5-base retriever (LLM-R)
models.architecture: bi-encoder, shared encoder, average pooling, cosine/tau

other.note: no log-probs from API; generation templates; max 1k examples per dataset

training.objective: Reward: cross-entropy over 1 positive and Nneg hard negatives. Retriever: L = alpha*InfoNCE + KL(p_reward || p_retriever) over hard negatives
training.hardware: 8 GPUs each (Table 7); candidate ranking on 8 V100 GPUs
training.compute: ranking with LLaMA-7B about 12 hours for 200k examples on 8 V100; retriever plus reward model training under 10 hours total

inference.decoding: classification: greedy with constrained decoding to valid labels; multiple choice: highest average token-level log-likelihood of options; generation: unconstrained greedy
inference.samples: single run per method; std dev 0.2 from 3 runs of the Random baseline only
inference.prompting: top-k retrieved examples concatenated with the test input; k=8 in main experiments
inference.retrieval: query = test input embedding, top-8 from pooled training set (~6.3M); k-means baseline uses 8 examples nearest to cluster centres

metrics.name: task metric (accuracy, ROUGE-L, F1, exact match per dataset)
metrics.definition: per Table 8; category average, then mean over categories

eval.protocol: Arithmetic mean of metrics; only Random baseline has std over 3 runs; no significance tests.

prompts.purpose: GPT-35-Turbo multiple-choice input (HellaSwag example): question, then OPTIONS: with A) to D), model outputs the option letter
prompts.text: What happens next in this paragraph?

limits: Examples are retrieved independently; interactions between in-context examples are ignored
Arithmetic mean of metrics disadvantages generation tasks (ROUGE/BLEU range narrower) and ignores dataset quality
Held-out tasks share categories with training tasks; non-overlapping categories left for future work
GPT-35-Turbo scores use different templates and are not comparable with other LLMs
Only the Random baseline has a std dev (3 runs); other differences carry no variance estimate
NQ train/test overlap acknowledged; SQuAD hurt by low diversity
Learned retriever needs training data and ~12h of LLaMA-7B ranking; gain is small for gpt-35-turbo
